svg.text: SGLang-native LLM post-training for RL scaling - Megatron train + SGLang rollout + Data Buffer
Prompt initialization and custom dataset loading
Rollout sample storage, filtering, and replay
Unified interface for agentic / multi-turn workflows
Connects training reads and rollout writes
Actor / Critic model updates (PPO, GRPO, etc.)
TP / PP / EP / CP full Megatron parallelism
Syncs updated weights to rollout after train step
sgl-router: single HTTP endpoint, load balance
Stores samples back into Data Buffer
weight sync: Megatron actor weights - SGLang rollout engines (delta / bucketed / full ckpt)
Explicit dataflow - correctness-first, debuggable per stage
Step 0: Load prompts / dataset - init Data Buffer with custom data paths
Step 1: Rollout - SGLang generate via sgl-router (custom-generate-function optional)
Step 2: Score - custom RM / verifier / rule-based reward / tool feedback
Step 3: Store - write (prompt, response, logprobs, reward) samples to Data Buffer
Step 4: Train - Megatron actor update from buffer batch (MFU monitored)
Step 5: Weight sync - push actor weights to SGLang (delta/bucketed/full) - loop
Sync: ray.get blocks until rollout completes - Async: overlap rollout N+1 with train N
DAPO oversampling: /abort_request terminates stragglers, reclaims partial rollouts
One RL kernel - plug agentic workflows without forking the trainer
Pipeline bridge: Megatron pretrain - slime post-train - SGLang deploy (shared ckpt format)
Production: GLM-4.5/4.6/4.7/5.x trained on slime - CPU unit + GPU e2e CI (dense + MoE)
Fault tolerance - reproducibility - trace viewer - profiling - debug rollout-then-train replay - multi-node MoE RL
Init path: Ray cluster - launch Megatron train workers + SGLang servers + sgl-router - init Data Buffer - load ckpt
Step path: rollout generate - reward - buffer store - Megatron train - weight sync - metrics/MFU - async ckpt - repeat
Sources: THUDM/slime README - LMSYS blog (2025-07-09) - thudm.github.io/slime docs - GLM-5 production validation
